name: opsman
description: Local-first meta-agent orchestrator for Dev and Ops tasks: discovers repository-local skills, selects the smallest team, runs a test-first evidence-gated loop with deterministic POSIX state, and gates completion behind an independent Oracle.

interface.shortDescription: Meta-agent orchestrator for Dev and Ops tasks
interface.longDescription: Use Opsman to discover repository-local skills, assemble the smallest suitable agent team, and drive a test-first, evidence-gated execution loop whose state survives switching between Claude Code and Codex.
